mentions.name: OneBusAway (OBA)
mentions.description: A suite of open source public transit software projects (OBA) run by the Open Transit Software Foundation, used by millions of transit riders every day around the world. Includes rider-facing apps, campus transit web apps, vehicle location software, and the next-generation Maglev server, with open volunteer roles for developers, biz dev, UX designers, and product managers.
mentions.audience: Millions of transit riders every day around the world, including in New York City, the Seattle area, San Diego, and Washington, D.C.
mentions.source_excerpt: I work on a suite of open source public transit software projects, collectively called OneBusAway (or OBA). The software is used by millions of transit riders every day around the world, including in New York City, the Seattle area, San Diego, and Washington, D.C.
mentions.author: aaronbrethorst
